ABOUT US

GRM GARMENTS

Complete Maternity & Nursing Wear Wholesale Hub

At GRM GARMENTS, we believe maternity retailers should be able to source a complete range of pregnancy and nursing wear from one reliable supplier.

We are a specialized B2B maternity and nursing-wear manufacturer and wholesale supplier, serving boutiques, maternity stores, baby stores, garment retailers, online sellers and resellers across India.

Our product range is built around the complete maternity journey — from pregnancy to nursing and everyday motherhood. Our collections include maternity and feeding dresses, feeding kurtis, feeding bras, pregnancy panties, feeding co-ord sets, pregnancy pants, maternity T-shirts, feeding shawls and aprons, bump-wear tops and other maternity essentials.

One Supplier. Multiple Maternity Categories.

Instead of requiring buyers to purchase a large quantity of a single product or design, GRM GARMENTS offers a more flexible wholesale buying model.

Our wholesale orders start from a minimum order value of ₹10,000, with the flexibility to mix products, designs, colours and sizes from available collections.

This allows retailers to build or expand their maternity section with greater variety while managing their investment more effectively.

Whether you already operate an established store or are starting a new maternity-wear business, our aim is to make wholesale sourcing simple, flexible and dependable.

Built for B2B Growth

GRM GARMENTS is more than a maternity dress supplier. We aim to become a complete sourcing partner for businesses serving pregnant and nursing mothers.

We focus on:

- A wide range of maternity and nursing categories
- Retail-friendly designs and practical products
- Consistent quality and manufacturing standards
- Flexible mixed-product wholesale purchasing
- Regular new collections
- Reliable stock and order fulfilment
- All-India wholesale supply
- Long-term relationships with retailers and resellers

Our goal is simple:

You build your maternity business. We help you source the products.

---

OUR MISSION

Our mission is to make maternity and nursing-wear wholesale sourcing easier, more flexible and more accessible for businesses across India.

We aim to provide retailers with a complete maternity product ecosystem under one roof, combining quality, variety, practical pricing and dependable service.

Through our flexible wholesale model, we want boutiques, retailers, online sellers and new entrepreneurs to be able to start or expand their maternity category without being forced to invest heavily in large quantities of a single design.

We are committed to continuously improving our products, manufacturing processes, quality control and service so that our B2B partners can confidently grow their businesses with GRM GARMENTS.

---

OUR VISION

Our vision is to establish GRM GARMENTS as one of India's trusted and recognized wholesale destinations for complete maternity and nursing wear.

We envision building a strong maternity-focused wholesale ecosystem where retailers across India can source multiple pregnancy and nursing categories from one dependable supplier.

As we grow, we aim to expand our product portfolio, strengthen our manufacturing capabilities, develop new maternity solutions and build a nationwide network of retailers, resellers and business partners.

Our long-term vision is clear:

One Supplier. Complete Maternity Collection. Endless Business Opportunities.

We want GRM GARMENTS to become the name businesses think of when they need to start, stock or expand a maternity-wear section.

---
